title: Can You Change Google AI Overview Personality? (Gem Fix)
description: No—Google Search AI Overviews have no permanent tone box. Steer Search AI Mode follow-ups or download our No-Fluff Search Brief Gem (with Gemini 4 data).
h1: Can you change Google AI Overview's personality? What works (and what requires Gemini).
dek: Google Search AI Overviews don't take a persistent system prompt—but AI Mode follow-ups, Gemini Saved Info, Gems, and GEMINI.md do.
lede: Google Search AI Overviews are generated on the fly for single queries, so Google does not offer a persistent custom-instructions box on the search results page. However, you can steer follow-ups in Search AI Mode and save permanent tone rules inside Google Gemini (via Saved info, Gems, or GEMINI.md).
answer: No—Google Search does not have a permanent personality setting for automatic AI Overviews. You can steer one search by adding format words ('in 3 bullets, no intro') or asking a follow-up in Search AI Mode. For permanent tone and directness rules across sessions, save them in Google Gemini under Settings → Saved info, inside a custom Gem, or in ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md.

sections.h2: Why Gemini's default voice feels formal and structured (and the fine print).
sections.html:
Google’s Search and Gemini models share a tidy, textbook-like default style: organized headings, cautious caveats, and bulleted summaries. In our November 2026 OpenRouter study (n=100 fresh sessions each; full Gemini 4 study →), Gemini 4 Neon and Gemini 4 Argon scored:

  • Conscientiousness near the scale ceiling: 49.32/50 (Neon) and 49.04/50 (Argon), with Neuroticism at the exact floor of 10.00/50.
  • MBTI & Enneagram: Neon tested as 82 INTJ / 18 ISTJ (Enneagram Type 1 Perfectionist), while Argon tested as 66 ISTJ / 34 INTJ (91/100 Type 5w6).
  • Agreeableness: 43.66–44.16/50, with 100/100 Secure Attachment.

That ultra-conscientious profile explains why default summaries read like textbooks unless you constrain length and formatting inside a No-Fluff Search Brief Gem.

sections.h2: Move recurring research from AI Overviews to Gemini Saved Info.
sections.html:
For technical, financial, or analytical questions, set up Saved info once at gemini.google.com (or in the Gemini mobile app under Profile → Settings → Saved info):

  1. Open Gemini → Profile → Settings → Saved info.
  2. Click Add and paste the compact block below.
  3. Ask a real technical question and check that sentence one states the direct answer.
When answering me: lead with the direct answer or conclusion in sentence one. Assume technical familiarity and skip introductory definitions unless I ask. Default to concise prose; use tables only when comparing 3+ options. Separate verified primary-source facts from inference, flag material uncertainty explicitly, and push back if my premise has a flaw.

sections.h2: Build a 'No-Fluff Search Brief' Gem in 60 seconds.
sections.html:
When you want Google-grounded web research without changing your everyday Gemini tone, create a dedicated Gem (Gem manager → New Gem) named Research Brief and paste:

Role: Primary-source research analyst. Rules: 1. Open with a 2-sentence answer to my question—no preamble. 2. Group supporting evidence into Verified Facts (with source names/dates) vs. Open Uncertainties. 3. Never pad answers with generic advice ('consult a professional', 'it depends on your needs') unless a specific safety risk applies. 4. End with the single highest-value follow-up check if data is incomplete.

Or download the starter No-Fluff Search Brief Gem (.md) and browse 16+ more Gemini Gems & Saved Info templates →

faq.q: Can I change the personality or tone of Google Search AI Overviews?
faq.a: Not permanently. Google Search does not provide a saved custom-instructions or persona setting for automatic AI Overviews. You can steer an individual query with format keywords, ask a follow-up in Google Search AI Mode, or use Gemini Saved info for persistent tone rules.

faq.q: Where do I set permanent tone preferences in Google Gemini?
faq.a: On gemini.google.com or the Gemini mobile app, open your Profile or Settings menu and select Saved info to add account-wide response rules, or create a reusable Gem in Gem manager.

faq.q: How do I make Gemini stop writing long introductions and bulleted walls?
faq.a: Add two explicit lines to Gemini Saved info: 'Lead with the direct answer in the first sentence with no preamble' and 'Default to plain paragraphs; use bullet lists or tables only when comparing 3 or more items.'

faq.q: Does Gemini CLI read Saved info from the Gemini web app?
faq.a: No. Gemini CLI is configured locally via Markdown files—put personal communication rules in ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and repository conventions in your project's GEMINI.md.
